situation: I am having trouble managing all 7 of my college classes and extracurricular activities.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Hi, how are you doing today?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Not too great, honestly.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Is there something in particular that's wrong?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I am struggling to keep up with all of the assignments in my classes and I am anxious that I am going to fail some of them.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: That sounds really stressful

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: It really is hard to manage

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Are you in a program that lets you choose your own classes?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Three of them were required for majors in my year, unfortunately.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Oh, that's rough. I've had classes before where I had to take them but had a lot of trouble.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Do you know anyone in the class? Maybe you could try studying with them and see if they can help.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I have a couple friends in the same classes but there is so much material it is hard to find any time to get together.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: It sounds like you're overwhelmed by all of the things expected of you

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Sometimes schools have programs that can help with this sort of thing, like student support services, that might be able to get you extensions on assignments, or move tests around if they fall on a similar date.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: That sounds like a great idea but I am not sure if they will have any sympathy for me.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: You might be right, it depends on the school honestly. It might not hurt to try though if you're really overwhelmed. Another thought is to try talking to your professors or TAs? They might be more sympathetic than you think.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: You're right. I guess it would be worth the time and effort to at least ask. That is probably better than just suffering.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I've been a TA for classes before, and even though I sometimes can't do too much to change assignment deadlines, I've always been open to talking to students about their struggles. It helps me to know who to keep an eye on and give extra attention to.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Are you feeling any external pressure from your family or advisor to do really well?

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I don't really have much of a support system. I really am just trying to self motivate.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: That sounds so hard, I think it's awesome that you're trying so hard on your own. Just the fact that you're in a program in the first place is really impressive.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thank you.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I hope you're able to find a support system through your friends, even if you don't have one at home.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: I hope so too.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thanks for talking with me.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: I know it's hard, but I think you're going to do a great job! And even if you fail a test, it really doesn't matter in the long run.

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: You are absolutely right.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: It was great talking with you

dialog.speaker: seeker
dialog.content: Thanks again! Bye.

dialog.speaker: supporter
dialog.content: Bye!
